name: Web Vitals Grader API
shortDescription: Grade measured LCP/INP/CLS against Google thresholds — per-metric ratings, CWV pass/fail, score, letter grade
description: Agent-native Core Web Vitals grader computed from public thresholds — no fetch, no LLM. /grade takes measured metric values (LCP, INP or legacy FID, CLS, plus optional FCP/TTFB) and returns each metric's rating (good / needs-improvement / poor), a Core Web Vitals pass/fail, a 0–100 score, and an A–F letter grade. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and prioritized, metric-specific fix recommendations. Deterministic, confidence 1.0; input-driven so it never times out fetching a page.

endpointPricing.description: Grade supplied Web Vitals → ratings, pass/fail, score
